title: Interstellar
description: A breathtaking cinematic journey across space and time. The visual design, soundtrack by Hans Zimmer, and the father-daughter emotional anchor make it an unforgettable masterpiece.

title: Breaking Bad
description: The golden standard of television drama. Walter White's descent from sympathetic chemistry teacher to ruthless kingpin is the greatest written character transformation.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
description: Revolutionary animation craft, unmatched visual storytelling, and high-stakes multi-dimensional drama. Every single frame belongs in a modern art museum.

title: Arcane
description: Fortiche and Riot achieved cinematic perfection. Complex character motivations, heart-wrenching emotional beats, and unmatched sound design.

title: Oppenheimer
description: A relentless 3-hour biographical thriller with incredible practical effects, haunting sound design, and Cillian Murphy's career-defining performance.

title: Attack on Titan
description: A masterclass in foreshadowing and narrative tension. A story about the devastating cycle of war, freedom, and human sacrifice.
